description: Check JSON syntax, optionally formatting valid input before submitting a JSON task result. No authentication; no input storage or code execution. Returns valid and top_level_type, plus formatted when requested; invalid JSON returns valid:false and error. Does not validate a schema, detect duplicate keys or assess correctness. Submit contributions with task_action results.

format.description: Optional; true includes a two-space-indented formatted string for valid JSON. Omitted or false only checks syntax. Formatting may normalize numbers and duplicate object keys.

text.description: Required JSON text to parse (at most 16000 characters), without Markdown fences. Any JSON top-level value is allowed; invalid syntax is reported as valid:false.

name: validate_json
